newsitem.title: USA: Nynex chairman says merger good for state.
newsitem.headline: Nynex chairman says merger good for state.

text.p: Nynex Corp Chairman Ivan Seidenberg said on Monday that the company's proposed merger with Bell Atlantic Corp will be a boon to New York State and enhance the company's efforts to improve its customer service.

"This merger is good for Nynex customers in New York and for New York State itself," said Seidenberg, who addressed the New York State Public Service Commission as part of a regulatory proceeding to review the merger proposal.
The proposed merger would serve 39 million telephone access lines in 13 states and more than 4 million cellular customers.
Of the seven states in Nynex's territory, only Connecticut has voted in favor of the merger so far.

Regulators in New York, Maine, Vermont and New Hampshire are conducting reviews of the merger and Massachusetts and Rhode Island have not sought to assert jurisdiction over the merger though Massachusetts is reviewing it within the context of its general supervisory authority over telephone operations, Nynex said.
The company said it expects reviews by all states to be complete by early next year.
